title: The structure of complexes between zinc(II) cations and histidine-rich repeats from the unstructured N-terminal domain of human prion protein
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,38422-38434
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04584C, Review Article

Michał Nowakowski, Joanna Wolak, Maciej Gielnik, Adam Piotrowski, Igor Zhukov, Justyna Żygowska, Aneta Szymańska, Marta D. Wiśniewska, Wojciech Bal, Sebastian K. T. S. Wärmländer, Maciej Kozak, Wojciech M. Kwiatek
Prion protein (PrPC), a well-known protein pathogenic agent, consists of an ordered C-terminal domain and an unstructured N-terminal tail. EXAFS shows it coordinates Zn2+ in octahedral geometry with four His groups involved.
